acceptance_criteria: Every Agility level from 57 to 98 is covered by at least one recommended method (no level gaps), with level requirements met at the point of use given the owner-stated stats and quests.
Every suggested step, method, quest and alternative carries a residual Danger Score per docs/05-danger-model.md, scored for the Hardcore Worlds death ruleset at the profile's Hitpoints.
The recommended (safest) route keeps every step at or below the owner's cap of 44, unless no alternative exists and the owner explicitly accepts that step; steps above the cap are flagged.

Every quest released in the recency window (2025-11-19 to 2026-11-19) that gives Agility XP or unlocks an Agility method is evaluated and either included in the route or rejected with a stated reason; November 2026 Quest Month quests are explicitly covered.
Content under 30 days old is marked as volatile, and unreleased or announced-only content is listed only under 'upcoming', never in the route.
No step relies on an activity reported unsafe on Hardcore Worlds being a safe death; any such activity is flagged with its Hardcore Worlds danger.
Requirements of each method/quest (skills, quests, items) are stated and checked against the profile; XP figures and levels are recomputed by the calc toolchain.
All factual statements trace to verified fact IDs from pinned T1/T2 sources; nothing is taken from docs/07 leads without verification.
No route pushes Defence above the build cap of 50 (tracked by the XP engine).
Every quest used lists its Defence XP so the cap can be tracked.
The guide offers next-step decision points with 2+ justified options at each meaningful fork.
